sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting atop the First Division South with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders have been in superb form with five consecutive wins before their most recent outing ended in a draw, maintaining an impressive unbeaten run. They face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points and a run of five consecutive defeats, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to consolidate their position.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second place and just two points behind Sandbach, host Dawley Town in what could be a pivotal encounter as they look to maintain the pressure on the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth (third, 19 points) face Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points) in a direct contest between top-four sides that could reshape the upper reaches of the table. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, entertain Wednesfield Community at home, seeking to build on their recent winning form. Elsewhere, Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) welcome struggling Foley Meir, whilst Barnton host Shawbury United in a fixture between mid-table outfit Barnton and bottom-half Shawbury, who have managed just one win in their last six. Market Drayton Town face New Mills—both teams in the lower half looking for points—and Brereton Social host Widnes Town, the basement club with just 2 points from 7 games. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in an all-bottom-half clash, whilst Crewe visit Allscott Heath in another lower-division fixture seeking a turnaround in their respective seasons.
